verdict.rationale: Sardine documents its own rule engine and a no-code rule editor that runs incoming transaction data against user-defined rules to flag anomalous behavior. It also describes automated outcomes such as auto-clearing low-risk sanctions matches and escalating real exposure. However, the docs do not describe what actions a rule can fire, how rules are tied to specific event triggers, or how that automation is configured. Missing for 10: documented rule-to-action configuration (e.g., block/route/notify on rule hit), explicit event-trigger definitions, rule-authoring depth or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Rules can be created around business entities through the rule engine.
